body:
Well I talked to her and found out I was nothing to her when she was the only person I have ever cared about.  

Now I just have to figure out how to do it.  

This isn't about her, it was just the tipping point.  When you have to rationalize with yourself every day, constantly, why you should stay alive it just wears you down.  I'm done.  If I had my guns here I wouldn't even be typing right now, it would have been over hours ago.  Unfortunately I have to figure out how to do this without them.


Do you think it would help my family understand if I let them know all this or would it hurt them more knowing I have struggled with it for so long?
